Below the cucumber lies a long, thin green bean or pea pod. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the textures of the vegetable skins.

The attachment points of the stems on the tomatoes appear slightly smeared and lack clear geometric definition, typical of AI soft-focus artifacts.
